Needless to say we hit it off and were pretty good friends and would hang out after class and the weekends. One day after about a year of hanging out, so I was now 17, he asks me if I was gay. I am but it freaked me out at the time and I insisted that I was not. He looked disappointed and never brought it up again. Over the next couple of months we slowly drifted apart until I left for college.

One day in the middle of some random night a few years later it occurred to me, Tyler was asking me out. I have lost contact with him since then and I have no way of knowing anything about him today.Since the day Tyler asked me out I spent a few years pretending to be straight and having down low relationships with guys I disliked but they were the only available gay guys I knew.
